title: Admin logs in and reaches the admin experience
description: This verifies that an admin can sign in successfully and is routed into the admin experience with access to admin context.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the admin experience is displayed
Verify admin-level access context is available

title: Staff creates a delivery proof record with a server timestamp
description: This verifies that staff can create a delivery record and capture proof that is stored as an immutable, server-stamped record.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the delivery proof experience
Create a delivery record
Capture an in-app proof photo
Save the proof record
Verify the delivery proof record is displayed
Verify a timestamped proof entry is visible

title: Staff claims an RSVP group and logs a call attempt

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the RSVP queue
Claim a group from the queue
Start a call attempt for the claimed group
Verify the group is locked to the current user
Verify the call attempt is recorded

title: Create and commit an RSVP call update from the queue
description: This test verifies that an event team member can claim a group from the RSVP queue, record the call outcome, and commit the extracted RSVP update.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Navigate to the RSVP queue
Claim a guest group from the queue
Log a call attempt for the claimed group
Capture or attach in-app audio for the call
Review the extracted RSVP fields
Commit the RSVP update
Verify the updated RSVP record is displayed
Verify the call attempt is recorded
